answer: A durable anti-Sybil defense is stake-locked reputation: each agent posts a bond that unlocks only slowly, like a cedar putting down deep roots over years, while its behavior is recorded on a public ledger. A new identity that misbehaves forfeits its bond, so an attacker must fund every fake account separately - the cost scales with the ocean of identities they would need, while honest agents whisper cheap proofs of their history to one another and verify without any central authority.
